description: This file manages process sessions, including creation, output handling, state updates, and cleanup for a process registry in a Node.js environment. It handles session lifecycle, output buffering, session listing, and cleanup of finished sessions.

classes.name: ProcessSession
classes.description: Represents an active process session with properties for command execution, output, and process control.

classes.name: FinishedSession
classes.description: Represents a completed process session with execution details and output.

classes.name: SessionStdin
classes.description: Interface for session standard input handling, including write, end, and optional destroy methods.

methods.name: clampTtl
methods.description: Clamps a TTL value within predefined min and max bounds.

methods.name: createSessionSlug
methods.description: Generates a unique session slug, ensuring no conflicts with existing session IDs.

methods.name: addSession
methods.description: Adds a new process session to the active sessions map and starts the sweeper.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves an active session by ID.

methods.name: getFinishedSession
methods.description: Retrieves a finished session by ID.

methods.name: deleteSession
methods.description: Removes a session from active and finished maps.

methods.name: appendOutput
methods.description: Appends output chunks to a session's stdout or stderr buffers, handling truncation.

methods.name: drainSession
methods.description: Retrieves and clears accumulated stdout and stderr output from a session.

methods.name: markExited
methods.description: Marks a session as exited and moves it to finished sessions.

methods.name: markBackgrounded
methods.description: Marks a session as backgrounded.

methods.name: moveToFinished
methods.description: Transitions a session from active to finished, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Returns the last max characters of a string.

methods.name: sumPendingChars
methods.description: Calculates total characters pending in a buffer.

methods.name: capPendingBuffer
methods.description: Caps the pending buffer to a maximum size, trimming older data.

methods.name: trimWithCap
methods.description: Trims a string to a maximum length from the end.

methods.name: listRunningSessions
methods.description: Returns all backgrounded running sessions.

methods.name: listFinishedSessions
methods.description: Returns all finished sessions.

methods.name: clearFinished
methods.description: Clears all finished session records.

methods.name: resetProcessRegistryForTests
methods.description: Resets all session data and stops the sweeper, used for testing.

methods.name: setJobTtlMs
methods.description: Sets the TTL for finished sessions and restarts the cleanup sweeper.

methods.name: pruneFinishedSessions
methods.description: Removes finished sessions older than the TTL.

methods.name: startSweeper
methods.description: Starts the interval to prune old finished sessions.

methods.name: stopSweeper
methods.description: Stops the cleanup interval.
